verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/run_manager.py:299-300: the `if name == "publish_brief": brief = dict(event.input)` branch runs before the `elif name in HOST_ACTION_TOOLS` branch (:301-306). publish_brief is itself a HOST_ACTION_TOOLS member, but that branch skips the AGENT-092 `undispatched` buffer. So the brief is stored when agent_runtime._consume_round yields the tool_use (agent_runtime.py:2912-2915), and that yield comes before the halt check at :2928-2946. src/lib/delegate-runs.ts:282-289 then enqueues output.brief on status 'error' too. It is kind 'panel', so AUTO auto-applies it.
verdicts.fix_shape: In run_manager.py, stop special-casing publish_brief ahead of the buffer. Let publish_brief tool_use events go into `undispatched` like every other host action. In `_on_tool_result`, when the popped action's name is 'publish_brief', set `brief = action['input']` and do not append it to host_actions. The brief then becomes the last DISPATCHED publish. A halted round's brief never lands, and it can no longer overwrite an earlier dispatched brief. No frontend change is needed.
verdicts.acceptance_test: sidecar/tests/test_run_manager.py::test_a_halted_rounds_brief_is_not_delivered. Round 1 is publish_brief {title:'dispatched brief'} with 10 tokens. Round 2 is publish_brief {title:'halted brief'} with 100k tokens, under RunBudget(max_tokens=1000). Assert row.status == 'error' and row.brief['title'] == 'dispatched brief'. Add a variant where round 1 is write_note and round 2 is the halted publish_brief, and assert row.brief is None. Live re-proof: `cd sidecar && ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest <scratch>/refaudit4-triage-b/a092/test_a092_brief.py -q -s` must print 'CASE1 ... BRIEF None' and 'CASE2 ... BRIEF {... 'dispatched brief' ...}'.
verdicts.failure_sources: R15-AGENT-092: its note has no 'certification failures so far' clause. It is certified (not in not_certified) in stage-c batch-12, and no regression_confirmed or partial verdict for it exists in REFUTATION_AUDIT.json or round-2. Baseline 0, plus 1 for this partial = 1.
verdicts.note: Reproduced at HEAD in-process with the repo's test_run_manager fixtures. In the shard's case the run halted with error, dispatched only ['write_note'], and host_actions was correct. row.brief still held the halted round's undispatched brief. A fresh case is worse: a halted round-2 publish_brief OVERWRITES the dispatched round-1 brief. The AGENT-092 fix covers every host action except publish_brief, which is a member of HOST_ACTION_TOOLS and is routed around the new buffer. So this is AGENT-092's class (announced-but-undispatched-tool, 'buffer tool_use events until the round's done') and reopens the tie. Severity stays medium, not the tie's high. The payload is the model's own brief, staged for review outside AUTO. No data write leaks, but in AUTO it auto-applies and can replace the real brief. The only related entries are AGENT-003 (the cap trigger) and AGENT-092 itself, so this is not a duplicate.

verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/agent_tools/research.py:536-540. fundamentals_content (used for fundamentals, compare_symbols and financial_statements via agent_runtime.py:783) rewrites only (*_STATEMENT_MONEY_FIELDS, 'market_cap') to displays. Every fraction field of the Fundamentals dump reaches the model as a bare float with no unit or display: dividend_yield, revenue_growth, earnings_growth, roe, the margins, held_percent_* and fifty_two_week_change. model_view (research.py:403-459) likewise leaves structured.fundamentals.data fractions raw beside the derived leg's unit 'fraction'. This contradicts semantics.display_value's contract at semantics.py:189-198.
verdicts.fix_shape: Use one shared field set, a module constant in research.py listing the Fundamentals fraction fields (dividend_yield, revenue_growth, earnings_growth, revenue_growth_computed, earnings_growth_computed, roe, roa, roce, gross_margin, operating_margin, profit_margin, held_percent_insiders, held_percent_institutions, fifty_two_week_change). In fundamentals_content, rewrite each numeric one to semantics.display_value(v, 'fraction', None) (e.g. '0.82%'), in the same loop that already rewrites money. In model_view, apply the same rewrite to structured.fundamentals.data. The model then never reads a raw fraction. The panel and auto-publish keep the raw payload, as they do for money today.

verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/research/finance.py:213-229 (_looks_like_ir) plus :237 (domain_tier). An ir./investor./investors. host counts as a company IR host, and so TIER_PRIMARY, when it is a strict subdomain of its PSL registrable domain and not on the ten-entry _IR_PLATFORM_DENYLIST (:89-103). A user-hostable platform that is neither a PSL private suffix nor enumerated has itself as the registrable domain (ghost.io, hashnode.dev, beehiiv.com, ...). So investors.ghost.io passes and ranks as the primary record.
verdicts.fix_shape: Stop granting TIER_PRIMARY on an IR host prefix alone. This is the fix_shape's own alternative. Add a TIER_IR that rank_sources orders below TIER_PRESS and that priority_note names 'company IR page' (never 'primary record (exchange/regulator/filings)'). Keep TIER_PRIMARY for PRIMARY_DOMAINS (exchanges, regulators, filings) only. No enumerated platform list can then leak a blog into PRIMARY or above Reuters. The known cost is that a real ir.<company>.com sorts after Tier-1 press, the side effect the batch-3 verifier already noted and accepted. If the IR tier must outrank press, corroborate it instead: pass the resolved subject into rank_sources/priority_note from iter.py:233/:888/:1098 and deep.py:467/:1122, and grant the higher rank only when the IR host's registrable-domain label matches the subject's name or symbol tokens.
verdicts.acceptance_test: sidecar/tests/test_research_finance.py::test_ir_prefix_on_an_unlisted_platform_is_never_primary. For https://investors.ghost.io/x, https://ir.hashnode.dev/x, https://investors.beehiiv.com/p/x, https://investors.tistory.com/1, https://ir.livejournal.com/x, https://ir.over-blog.com/x, https://ir.quora.com/x, https://ir.typepad.com/x and https://ir.mailchimpsites.com/x, assert domain_tier(u) != TIER_PRIMARY. Assert rank_sources([Reuters, investors.ghost.io, ir.hashnode.dev])[0].title == 'Reuters' and that priority_note(...) does not contain 'primary record' for markers 2 and 3. Controls: sec.gov/nseindia.com stay TIER_PRIMARY. Live re-proof: `cd sidecar && ./.venv/bin/python <scratch>/refaudit4-triage-b/r007/probe.py` must print RANKED ['Reuters', ...] first and no FRESH host at tier 1.
verdicts.failure_sources: R15-RESEARCH-007: its note has no clause. Baseline 2: stage-c batch-12 VERDICTS not_certified (1) plus the rc1 round-1 REFUTATION_AUDIT.json partial (1). Batch-3 and batch-13 are certified. Plus 1 for this partial = 3.
verdicts.note: Reproduced at HEAD in-process. The literal repro holds: medium/wordpress give 3, Reuters 2, and the IR controls 1. Every one of the shard's fresh user-hostable platforms gives tier 1 (ghost.io, hashnode.dev, beehiiv.com, tistory.com, livejournal.com, over-blog.com, quora.com, mystrikingly.com, webnode.page, jimdosite.com, site123.me, typepad.com), and so does my own ir.mailchimpsites.com. rank_sources puts GhostBlog and HashnodeBlog ahead of Reuters, and priority_note names them 'primary record ... [1, 2]'. This is the tie's own class (source-authority-heuristic, 'none reaches TIER_PRIMARY and Reuters outranks them'), and it is the third fresh-case leak of an enumerated exclusion, so the tie is reopened. Severity was lowered from high to medium: exposure is limited to an exact ir/investor/investors label on an un-enumerated non-PSL platform surfacing for the company, the URL is visible in the brief, and no core flow breaks. I discarded wix.com, squarespace.com and blogger.com as evidence because those can be genuine corporate IR hosts.

verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/research/fast.py:697 (`structured, web = await asyncio.gather(_structured(), _web())`) with fast.py:675-695. `_web()` awaits _web_round, which calls the web_search tool with no time box at the FAST level, while every structured leg is boxed at _WITNESS_LEG_TIMEOUT_S = 6 s (:101-105). The keyless chain allows 3 x ENGINE_DEADLINE_SECS 6 s = 18 s, plus pacing, under the 25 s tool cap (search/keyless.py:61-67). A stalled web round therefore holds the NORMAL bundle for 18-25 s against the FR-070 budget of 15 s.
verdicts.fix_shape: In fast.py `_web()`, await `_web_round(...)` under `asyncio.wait_for` with a FAST web budget constant, e.g. `_WEB_ROUND_TIMEOUT_S = 8.0`, which fits inside 15 s together with the prose turn. On TimeoutError, return the honest web section {available: False, citations: [], results: [], reason: 'timeout', note: 'Web search did not answer within 8s — structured data only'} and emit the search step with status 'skipped' and its latency_ms. Keyless and the web_search tool cap stay unchanged; only the NORMAL caller is bounded. DEEP/ULTRA keep their own walls.
verdicts.acceptance_test: sidecar/tests/test_research_fast.py: add ('web_search', 'web', None) to the parametrisation of test_a_stalled_leading_leg_is_time_boxed_and_the_rest_publish, or add test_a_stalled_web_round_is_time_boxed. With _SlowLegToolCall('web_search') (a 20 s sleep), assert elapsed < 10.0, bundle['web']['available'] is False with a note naming the timeout, structured['fundamentals']['ok'] is True, and that a 'search' step carries latency_ms >= the box. Live re-proof: `cd sidecar && ./.venv/bin/python -u <scratch>/refaudit4-triage-b/r027/r027.py <scratch data> stall Saksoft "Tata Elxsi"` must print wall_s < 15 for both.
verdicts.failure_sources: R15-RESEARCH-027: its note has no clause. It appears in not_certified once (stage-c batch-8) and is certified in batch-9. No verdict in REFUTATION_AUDIT.json or round-2. Baseline 1, plus 1 for this partial = 2.
verdicts.note: Reproduced at HEAD two ways. (1) Offline and deterministic with the repo's own _SlowLegToolCall fixture on the web_search leg: the structured fan-out finished in 882 ms but the bundle returned at 20.0 s. (2) In-process with the real resolver and providers and the ddg/brave/mojeek search() stalled, as in the shard: Saksoft 24.4 s and Tata Elxsi 18.4 s, with structured done at about 6 s both times. The prose turn comes on top. The entry's stated 33-38 s repro no longer holds, but the tie's class ('per-leg timeout so the fast path still publishes within budget', 'publish the cockpit before web + prose') leaves the web leg unboxed. keyless.py:63-67 even documents 18 s for the web leg, so this reopens the tie. Severity stays medium: the answer still arrives, honestly labelled structured-only, within the 25 s tool cap. Not a duplicate of RESEARCH-008, whose 25 s tool-cap bound holds.

verdicts.root_cause: src/modules/news/NewsFeedPanel.tsx:206-219 publishes only {watchedSymbols, focusedArticleId}. The id is an opaque sha1 of url+title (sidecar/services/news_provider.py:138), and no headline or title is published. src/modules/chat/context-provider.ts:272-273 (genericPanelSummary) then collapses watchedSymbols to 'N items'. The agent's whole view of the News panel, through get_terminal_state (agent_runtime.py:1676-1677), is therefore 'watchedSymbols=2 items, focusedArticleId=<sha1>'. That the preamble omits otherPanels (agent_runtime.py:404-481) is by design (the docstring says detail comes via get_terminal_state), so it is not part of the defect.
verdicts.fix_shape: In NewsFeedPanel's publish effect, publish scalars the generic summary keeps. Replace or accompany focusedArticleId with `focusedHeadline` (the hovered item's title, looked up from state.items by focusedArticleId), and add `topHeadline` (state.items[0]?.title) when the feed is ready. Add both to the effect deps. In genericPanelSummary, render an array of primitives inline (the first few values joined by ',') instead of 'N items', within the existing 200-char cap. The watched symbols then survive too. No preamble change is needed.

Assert otherPanels news.summary contains 'Apple beats on services' and 'AAPL'. Update the pinned 'watchedSymbols=2 items' expectation at :236. src/modules/news/NewsFeedPanel.test.tsx: render with two items, fire mouseEnter on the second row, and assert usePanelContextBus.getState().lastEventBySource.news.payload.focusedHeadline equals that item's title. verdicts.failure_sources: R15-AGENT-053: the latest note clause is 'certification failures so far: 1' (rc1 round-2 REFUTATION_AUDIT partial; certified in batch-10 and batch-25). Plus 1 for this partial = 2.
verdicts.note: Reproduced at HEAD. A scratch vitest publishes exactly NewsFeedPanel's payload, and captureTerminalState gives news otherPanels summary 'watchedSymbols=2 items, focusedArticleId=3f1c...' with no headline and no symbol names. The in-process _build_context_preamble gives only 'Focused panel: news. Open panels: news.' The tie's stated acceptance ('open Backtest and News -> snapshot carries their run id/headlines') and repro ('ask the copilot about what is on screen') fail for News, while the backtest run id and the symbol buttons hold. Of the shard's three sub-claims, the preamble not rendering otherPanels is by design (the agent_runtime.py:404-411 docstring routes detail through get_terminal_state, which returns otherPanels), so it is not counted. Severity stays medium. No other register entry covers the news payload content.

verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/yahoo_batch_provider.py:322 records every post-retry chunk 429 as provider_health.record_rate_limited(provider_health.YAHOO) at weight 1.0, whoever the caller is. The background warm loops (screener.py:1338 _warm_once, fundamentals_warm.py:178) call the same fetch_quotes_batch as the user screener (screener.py:957) and cannot mark their traffic as background. Three throttled warm cycles therefore open the YAHOO circuit (_OPEN_THRESHOLD = 3, provider_health.py:52) that gates the user paths (screener.py:550 and :1070, yahoo_batch_provider.py:276).
verdicts.fix_shape: Add a keyword `throttle_weight: float = 1.0` to yahoo_batch_provider.fetch_quotes_batch and thread it to _fetch_chunk. Pass it to provider_health.record_rate_limited(provider_health.YAHOO, weight=throttle_weight), a parameter that already exists. The two background callers, screener._warm_once and fundamentals_warm's batch call, pass a low constant (e.g. _WARM_THROTTLE_WEIGHT = 0.25). Their own streak/backoff still slows them, but warm 429s alone can no longer open the circuit user requests read, while user-path 429s keep weight 1.0.
verdicts.acceptance_test: sidecar/tests/test_b5_screener.py::test_warm_429s_alone_do_not_open_the_user_circuit. Fake the batch client to return 429 and set _warm_universe='nifty50' with 50 symbols. Run screener._warm_once() three times and assert provider_health.is_open(YAHOO) is False, and that a following user fetch_quotes_batch(['RELIANCE.NS']) makes an HTTP call instead of short-circuiting. Control: three user-path fetch_quotes_batch 429s still open it. Live re-proof: `cd sidecar && ./.venv/bin/python <scratch>/refaudit4-triage-b/l020/warm429.py <scratch data>` must print is_open=False after warm cycle 3 and a user fetch that spends an HTTP call.
verdicts.failure_sources: R15-LIFECYCLE-020: its note is empty. It is certified in stage-c batch-5 and is not in any not_certified list. No verdict in REFUTATION_AUDIT.json or round-2. Baseline 0, plus 1 for this partial = 1.
verdicts.note: Reproduced at HEAD in-process and deterministically, with only HTTP faked to 429. Three background _warm_once cycles over nifty50, with no user traffic, took yahoo consecutive_throttles 1 -> 2 -> OPEN for 68 s. The user's next _fetch_pair('RELIANCE.NS') returned (None, 'rate_limited') and fetch_quotes_batch marked both symbols rate_limited, each with zero HTTP calls. This matches the shard's live observation (a warm cycle after a nifty50 run moved yahoo throttles_total 236 -> 238). The stated repro (a US-only S&P 500 loop at boot) is fixed. The entry's root cause ('on the same circuit user requests use') and fix_shape clause 3 ('keep background warming from opening the circuit user requests share: a separate budget or a lower-priority weight') were never implemented: commit 4c2e78fb and the batch-5 PLAN dropped the clause. That makes it a stated part of the tie, so the tie reopens. provider_health.record_rate_limited already takes a weight, so the fix is small. Severity stays medium. This is not a duplicate of DATA-110 or DATA-072.
